title: Examination Disguised As Research
paragraphs: “Even though you’ve become a great Dragon Emperor, why would you take on a human form… how lamentable.”
“Ah, is that how it is from a dragon’s perspective?”
“No, that’s just my sister’s personal opinion.”
“Hmm… I wonder which one is right.”
“With this, I won’t lose to the Filolials! Gaelion can sleep with Naofumi and the others too!”

Rival is casually bouncing on the bed where Mole is sitting. A misbehaving brat should sleep alone in the dragon stables. Being quiet on the bed like the Filolial-sama… I think even Sakura-chan and Kou did that. Filolial-sama are admirable!
“Or should Gaelion sleep in Naofumi’s bed? Got it, Gaelion will wash up and wait!”
“Don’t decide before I answer…”
“Ugh! No way!”
Sakura-chan spread her arms wide to protect Father and started glaring at Rival. Should I join in as well?
“How should I put it, Naofumi-san. It’s too noisy to sleep, you know?”
“Huh? This is my fault?”
Father is also struggling to handle the situation.
“Then I shall paralyze Rival and throw her outside.”
“Denied!”
Just as I was about to take down Rival, Father grabbed me by the collar. Father is taking the peaceful route this time.
“Wyndia-chan, please keep Gaelion in check.”
“Okay!”
“Um, Gaelion-chan. You’re still young, so you shouldn’t say things like that, okay?”
“It’s fine! If Gaelion wants to, I can become an adult!”
“Then why that appearance?” Ren joined in and asked.
Indeed, why take on the form of a child?
“Gaelion fights fair and square. I won’t lose to the Filolials!”
Is this some kind of provocation? Is Gaelion trying to match Sakura-chan and the others, who remain in their youthful forms?
“That’s not the point. It’s fine to sleep in the same room, but if you say too many troublesome things, I’ll get angry.”
When Father gently admonished, Rival thought for a moment and then obediently nodded. Get scolded and make it a trauma, I say!
“Got it! But Gaelion won’t give up on Naofumi! Someday, Gaelion will definitely become Naofumi’s bride!”
“I’m not giving you a promise on that, okay?”

Even Father couldn’t just brush it off this time, probably because of Sakura-chan and Mole’s gazes. Even if he refuses, with that tough spirit, she won’t give up. So, it seems he left it as a pending matter.
“Naofumi-san, you’ve got it rough.”
“It’s not just my imagination that this feels like a father being told by a child that they’ll be their bride in the future, right?”
“Being a daycare worker is tough.”
“Why did you rephrase it? And could you stop pretending this has nothing to do with you?”
“No, no, this is Naofumi’s unique problem. Good for you, you’re so popular.”

Ren is saying random things. Sakura-chan is gripping Father’s hand tightly. Somehow, it reminds me of how, in the first world, Filo-tan desperately tried to stop Rival from clinging to Father. Ah… Filo-tan.
“As for Motoyasu-san, he’s already lying down, looking like he’s in a dream.”
“Sleeping next to Motoyasu-sama… this is heaven.”
“It’s noisy but fun!”
As I was getting lost in a dreamy state, overlapping Sakura-chan with Filo-tan, Éclair glanced at us with a slightly exasperated expression.
“What is this? It reminds me of the attitude of new recruits back in the knight dormitory days.”
“Ah… yeah, I guess the atmosphere is similar? I’m getting the same vibes as a training camp.”
“Indeed. Anyway, Naofumi-san, we want to sleep, so please calm things down quickly.”
“You’re dumping everything on me? Seriously… geez…”
“Gaelion, I understand that you want to sleep with everyone, but don’t be too selfish, okay?”
“Okay! I’ll be patient today and sleep with my sister and Imiya-chan.” Rival energetically raised her hand.
“That’s why Sakura shouldn’t sleep with Naofumi. Otherwise, Gaelion will take Naofumi’s bed.”
“Ugh…”
Reluctantly, Sakura-chan moved away from Father and decided to sleep with Yuki-chan and the others. Ah, the nostalgic atmosphere carries my consciousness off to the world of dreams…
“Hmm, then I’ll return to my watch. Call me if anything happens.”
“Eclair-san, are you sure you don’t need to sleep?”
“It’s fine. I’ll take turns watching with trustworthy castle guards. I’ll sleep after my shift is over.”
After that, Father and the others went to bed fairly early. The next morning.
“Checkups for Sakura-chan and Gaelion-chan?”
While we were having breakfast, the castle staff explained the day’s schedule. By the way, our checkups were done while riding the carriage during our travels.
“Well, I guess it’s necessary.”
“In Japan, they give pets vaccinations too. Everyone’s growing up healthy, but if they get sick, it’ll be a big problem.”
“Isn’t this so-called checkup actually research?”
At Ren’s words, Father and the others, including me, nodded. I see, the Filolial Queen and the Dragon Emperor are valuable research subjects.
“That said, wouldn’t it be good to have them examined at least once from various perspectives? Like Itsuki said, for vaccinations and health purposes.”
“If Naofumi thinks so, then it’s fine, right? They wouldn’t forcibly conduct research on the subordinates of the Hero.”
“Didn’t that king Motoyasu mentioned dismantle the alchemy faction conducting research on homunculi?”
“Seems so. I only heard it second-hand, but it was apparently a place that also treated humans… supposedly under Takt’s influence.”
“That’s different from a clinic, isn’t it?”
Was that what they were talking about? I was probably playing with the Filolial-sama at the time. For now, I’ll just quietly observe the situation.
“Motoyasu, why are you acting like this doesn’t concern you? You’re the one responsible for the Filolials.”
“I’m also Father’s son-in-law, I say.”
“Naofumi’s in charge of Sakura and Gaelion. Yuki and Kou are your responsibility, aren’t they?”

Ren ended up scolding me. Even if he hadn’t said anything, I planned to leave everything to Father. Well, I’ll at least check what kind of people are examining Yuki-chan and the others. If they try anything foolish, their lives are forfeit. Shush, shush!
“And there’s also the matter of Gaelion-chan’s clothes.”
“What is it?”
Rival, still in human form, is wearing the clothes Éclair prepared. Is that the form she’ll fight in during battle?
“Well, I suppose she’ll create threads with magic, like Sakura-chan does.”
“That much can be disguised with magic.”
“Disguise… Well, you’re better at magic than Sakura-chan and the others, after all.”
“Yep!”
Rival seems to be getting a little too full of herself, doesn’t she? Perhaps it’s time to hammer down the nail that sticks out and teach her some humility.
“Either way, I think we should at least check if Gaelion-chan or Sakura-chan show any signs of illness.”

Exactly. Even if I and Father are specialists in Filolials, there might be things we miss. If the doctor has reliable skills and character, it wouldn’t be bad to leave it to them. Assistant tilted her head, not quite understanding Father’s words.
“Wyndia-chan, you don’t quite get it?”
“Hmm…?”
“Well, since you were raised by wild dragons, maybe you’ve never seen it.”
“Um, using medicine to treat subordinates?”
“Something like that? Did your father do that, Wyndia-chan?”
Assistant shook her head. So, he didn’t?
“Father’s partner was a monster knowledgeable about medicinal herbs.”
“Then you should be able to understand, right? They’re just checking their health, right?”
“Oh, in that case, Father did that too!”
“Treatment and checkups are different, so Wyndia-chan probably didn’t make the connection.”
Ah, I see. It’s probably like how dogs sniff each other to analyze the other’s health. I couldn’t care less about Rival’s biology.
